metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code skills by jukben

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial reasoning and decision stress-testing. Pressure-test arguments, run pre-mortems, play devil's advocate, and generate structured Decision Records.

plugins.name: pr-pipeline
plugins.description: PR lifecycle skills: tier-aware self-review with parallel agents (code review, PR shape, test/CI, security, requirements), confidence scoring to filter false positives, draft PR with optional ticket prefix, and babysit through merge with persistent state-diffing monitor (event-driven, quiet until something changes) and smart review thread resolution.
